scope: All shared company navigation widgets, header preference controls and tour TOC across WPML locales; one WordPress site per company

authority.company_kit: Use Elementor active Kit as the only brand-color/typography authority. Source name, visual palette and menu states are never copied from another company's demo.
authority.typography: Use globals/typography?id=text or relevant active Kit typography token, not standalone font or hardcoded named brand
authority.layout: Component-specific responsive layout may define padding, radius, height and scroll; these are nonbrand UX dimensions requiring separate review if changed
authority.customer_labels: Public client control is localized as Passport; backend market_country and nationality fields retain existing verified meanings
authority.no_color_literals: No brand hex/rgb named literals in new navigation/TOC company CSS. Neutral shadow alpha is documented as a non-brand visual affordance.

templates.geometry_policy: Only change settings.__globals__ colors in source templates with exact ID and source expected; do not change widget types, headings, price fields, links, nested order or Elementor JSON elsewhere

kit_integrity.provisioning_policy: BLOCK new company activation on any duplicated _id regardless of value: must import only unique validated semantic tokens
kit_integrity.existing_site_policy: Record legacy duplicates as open debt, do not blindly delete/rename Kit tokens while existing templates may reference them; newly edited navigation widgets must not reference duplicated IDs
kit_integrity.kit_save_policy: Any intended Kit change requires source-backed diff and distinct authorized design approval; never promote demo-only palette to another tenant
kit_integrity.fallback: If semantic global is missing, flag invalid configuration instead of using a second company's palette

mobile_toc.behavior: HTML details disclosure closed by default; section groups with nested native anchor links, scroll cap 58dvh, proper keyboard semantics
mobile_toc.source: Existing Elementor TOC anchor links; no new or altered heading ids; desktop retains native TOC when viewport changes
mobile_toc.locale: EN AR FR DE IT ES, labels from current HTML language
mobile_toc.fallback: If native TOC has no links yet, retain existing Elementor markup; augment only after anchors are available

release_gate: Verify same-target host and site identity with company/site_uuid for all writes
Snapshot source metadata in memory, exact compare-and-swap updates, readback
Audit active Kit semantic tokens and list duplicate custom IDs
Block new nonsemantic or ambiguous Kit color bindings in shared company navigation widgets
CSS and runtime JS only for documented header/menu/TOC components, with mobile scope; no Elementor node redesign
Check hover/focus/active and dropdown at desktop, native TOC restored on resize, mobile nested anchors work
All six WPML templates have same global color refs and independent translated copy
PR CI before promotion, no Production write without authorized deployment approval
